capability.title: Site Header Navigation
capability.description: Fixed site header with the brand wordmark, active-aware desktop navigation, a primary call to action, and a mobile sheet menu.
useWhen: The site needs one shared header rendered across every page
Primary navigation and a single call to action should stay pinned to the top
avoidWhen: A page needs its own local navigation rather than the site-wide header
Navigation must render below the first screen
